scope: Read-only report and selected artifact audit at 14 accepted trials; final Flat task 5 was pending. No edits or reruns.
rawCompletedReport:
The 057 conclusions fit an exploratory, single-sequence review. The 14/15 accepted count and task metrics match the saved metrics; the task 3 trace/log error difference is explained, and spot checks support the reuse, state-preservation, and task 4 coverage claims. The report avoids efficiency, native-performance, and full-PRD claims. Its proposed small workflow improvements and rotated repetitions follow the evidence.

Two documentation gaps to consider: report 056 records non-identical launch messages and a Growing task 1 transport clarification, which 057 does not repeat. Also, only 10 of 14 accepted trial folders contain pin.json; Conventional tasks 2/3, Flat task 2, and Growing task 1 lack one. I could not establish whether their provenance is recorded elsewhere. The root inventory still says six-accepted-task1-and-task2-trials, while the evaluation document says no comparative results yet; these may be stale labels, though the latter could be a historical protocol.

I found no material arithmetic inconsistency in the 057 tables. No files were changed and no trials were rerun.
rootResolution: Retained raw report; transport clarification was Growing task 2, as report 056 states, rather than reviewer shorthand task 1.
Reconstructed four absent per-trial provenance files from retained session-start binary/allowlist records and coordinator preparation, explicitly labeling post-run reconstruction.
Inventory and status labels updated on completion of the final trial; root independently audits final trial acceptance and metrics.
